# Keys

One table resolves a key press, fills the footer, fills the `?` overlay, and renders this page. A key absent from it does nothing and appears nowhere, which is what keeps the four surfaces from disagreeing about what a key does.

A pane's own bindings are checked before the global ones, so a pane can shadow a global key. Where it does, the pane's row says what the key does there.

## Everywhere

Live in every pane and every mode, unless the focused pane binds the same key.

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `j` | move down |
| `k` | move up |
| `tab` | focus the next pane |
| `shift+tab` | focus the previous pane |
| `?` | toggle the key list |
| `q` | quit |
| `esc` | leave the mode or discard the search |
| `ctrl+d` | scroll down half a page |
| `ctrl+u` | scroll up half a page |
| `g` | jump to the top |
| `G` | jump to the bottom |
| `R` | toggle the run history |
| `r` | reload the workspace |
| `b` | toggle the response-time budgets |

## Files

Live while the workspace tree holds focus.

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `l` | expand the directory |
| `h` | collapse the directory |
| `enter` | open the selected file |

## Preview

Live while the file preview holds focus.

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `/` | search the file |
| `n` | jump to the next match |
| `N` | jump to the previous match |
| `h` | return to the tree |

## Activity

Live while the activity feed holds focus.

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `enter` | open the file the entry names |
| `f` | follow the newest entry |

## Runs

Live while the run history holds focus, which replaces the tree in run mode.

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `enter` | open the selected run |

## Search prompt

Live while the search prompt is open. Every other key is text, including keys that are bound elsewhere.

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `enter`, `ctrl+n` | jump to the next match |
| `ctrl+p` | jump to the previous match |
| `esc` | discard the query |
